title: Why does milk boil over but water doesn't?
caption:
Looked away for 5 seconds and the milk exploded? 🥛😭
When milk heats up, its proteins and fat form a thin skin on top. Steam bubbles get trapped under it, pile up, and push the skin up like a lid… until it all comes over.
Water has no skin, so its bubbles just pop.
Fix: lower the flame and keep stirring.
Send this to the friend whose chai always boils over ☕
